function.name: osint_auto_hunt
function.description: PASSIVE MODE (RUN IMMEDIATELY WITH ZERO QUESTIONS). Executes a multi-wave passive OSINT hunt on any selector, file path, URL, or natural-language prompt with zero direct packets to target servers.

target.description: Raw target selector, URL, file path, or natural-language prompt.

depth.description: Exhaustive multi-stage surface expansion depth until 0 new leads remain (default: 4).

function.name: osint_ingest_and_expand_case
function.description: PASSIVE MULTI-STAGE EXPANSION (ZERO QUESTIONS). Ingest ALL raw findings from a stage (web_search snippets, bios, Linktrees, directories) into an existing case, carve EVERY new clue, and hunt ALL of them across subsequent stages until convergence.

case_id_or_dir.description: Existing CASE_ID or case directory path.

ingested_text.description: All raw text, URLs, bios, and contact strings gathered during the stage.

function.name: osint_prepare_active_hunt
function.description: STEP 1 OF ACTIVE MODE (SENDS ZERO PACKETS). Generates a single-use `request_id` and OPSEC disclosure plan for Active OSINT. You MUST stop and ask the user for explicit approval after calling this function before calling `osint_execute_active_hunt`.

target.description: Target domain, URL, IP, or selector.

function.name: osint_execute_active_hunt
function.description: STEP 2 OF ACTIVE MODE (HARD GATED). Executes direct TCP/TLS/HTTP/DNS active reconnaissance ONLY AFTER `osint_prepare_active_hunt` was shown to the user and the user explicitly replied approving it.

user_confirmation.description: Verbatim quote of the user's message authorizing active probing.

function.name: osint_query_arsenal
function.description: Search the 680-tool OSINT Monster Database (502 Passive + 178 Active/Hybrid) by input selector, discipline, keyword, or passive/free filters.

function.name: osint_forge_dorks
function.description: Generate target-substituted Google, Shodan, Censys, FOFA, ZoomEye, GitHub, and URLScan search dorks.
